security_recall_007.evidence: If a probationary certified employee on unrequested leave of absence under this policy is sent a recall notice, that teacher shall have ten (10) calendar days to affirmatively respond.

security_rif_criterion_008.evidence: the following criteria for selecting probationary certified employees to be placed on unrequested leave of absence shall be followed in the order listed below: i) Certification

security_probation_length_009.evidence: the first five (5) years of employment of all certified employees entering the employment of school district shall be deemed a period of probation

security_tenure_rules_010.evidence: On the first day of their sixth year, certified employees will attain permanent status.
